effects.summary_cn: 从牌库或声望范围内拿取1张牌。
effects.summary_en: Take one card from the deck or from within reputation range.

effects.summary_cn: 终局科研图标达到3/6个时得1/2保护分。
effects.summary_en: Score 1/2 conservation for reaching 3/6 research icons.

effects.summary_cn: 每当科研图标进入你的动物园，获得1声望。
effects.summary_en: Whenever a research icon enters your zoo, gain 1 reputation.

effects.summary_cn: 支持保护项目时，协会行动强度4即可。
effects.summary_en: Supporting a conservation project requires Association strength 4 instead of 5.

effects.summary_cn: 每当科研图标进入你的动物园，获得1保护分。
effects.summary_en: Whenever a research icon enters your zoo, gain 1 conservation.

effects.summary_cn: 提供科研图标，并立即获得2声望和1保护分。
effects.summary_en: Provides its printed science icon plus 2 reputation and 1 conservation.

effects.summary_cn: 收入阶段获得1保护分。
effects.summary_en: Gain 1 conservation during income.

effects.summary_cn: 按符合条件的不同洲/动物类别图标组合获得保护分；你每因此获得1保护分，其他玩家获得2金钱。
effects.summary_en: Gain conservation for qualifying pairs of different continent and/or animal-category icons; opponents gain 2 money per conservation you gain this way.

effects.summary_cn: 每当任意动物园获得科研图标，你获得2金钱。
effects.summary_en: Whenever a research icon enters any zoo, gain 2 money.

effects.summary_cn: 若动物园拥有5种动物类别图标，终局得1保护分。
effects.summary_en: Gain 1 conservation if your zoo has all five animal-category icons.

effects.summary_cn: 收入阶段获得1个X标记。
effects.summary_en: Gain 1 X-token during income.

effects.summary_cn: 每当美洲图标进入你的动物园，可免费放置1个小卖部。
effects.summary_en: Whenever an Americas icon enters your zoo, you may place a kiosk for free.

effects.summary_cn: 每当欧洲图标进入你的动物园，可免费建造1个1格围栏。
effects.summary_en: Whenever a Europe icon enters your zoo, you may build a size-1 enclosure for free.

effects.summary_cn: 若有5个已占用的1格围栏，终局得1保护分。
effects.summary_en: Gain 1 conservation if you have five occupied size-1 enclosures.

effects.summary_cn: 每当澳大利亚图标进入你的动物园，可将1张手牌压在此牌下并获得2魅力。
effects.summary_en: Whenever an Australia icon enters your zoo, you may tuck one hand card for 2 appeal.

effects.summary_cn: 每当亚洲图标进入你的动物园，可免费放置1个凉亭。
effects.summary_en: Whenever an Asia icon enters your zoo, you may place a pavilion for free.

effects.summary_cn: 每当非洲图标进入你的动物园，可将任意行动牌移到1号位。
effects.summary_en: Whenever an Africa icon enters your zoo, you may move any action card to slot 1.

display.summary: Level 4 sponsor; timings: immediate, passive, endgame.
display.title: Breeding Cooperation

effects.summary_cn: 在此牌上放置2个自己的玩家标记。
effects.summary_en: Place 2 of your player tokens on this card.

effects.summary_cn: 支持基础保护项目时，可花掉1个储存标记，将其视为任意所需图标。
effects.summary_en: When supporting a base conservation project, you may spend exactly one stored token as a wildcard icon.

effects.summary_cn: 若已支持至少5个保护项目，终局得1保护分。
effects.summary_en: Gain 1 conservation if you supported at least five conservation projects.

effects.summary_cn: 雇用1名协会工作人员。
effects.summary_en: Hire one association worker.

effects.summary_cn: 建造行动至少建造1个建筑后，可按正常费用额外再建造1个同类建筑；特殊围栏除外。
effects.summary_en: When your Build action constructs at least one building, you may construct exactly one additional building of the same kind at normal cost; special enclosures are excluded.

effects.summary_cn: 社区转录将此牌关联到与“繁育合作”相同的标记/万能图标/终局模式；用于规则引擎前建议与实体牌核对。
effects.summary_en: Community transcription links this card to the same token/wildcard/endgame pattern as Breeding Cooperation; verify against your physical card before rules-engine automation.

resources_or_markers: source-transcription note; token use requires verification

effects.summary_cn: 可在岩石/水域格建造并忽略岩石/水域摆放要求；打出时，每个牌面岩石/水域要求获得2金钱。
effects.summary_en: You may build on rock/water spaces and may ignore rock/water placement requirements; when played, gain 2 money for each rock/water requirement shown.

effects.summary_en: Gain 1 conservation per research icon; for each conservation gained this way, other players gain 2 money.

effects.summary_cn: 无独立文字效果；提供2个科研图标。
effects.summary_en: No separate text effect; provides two research icons.

effects.summary_cn: 每次支持放归项目时额外获得1保护分；同一放归项目可被你多次支持。
effects.summary_en: Whenever you support a Release project, gain 1 additional conservation; you may support each Release project more than once.

effects.summary_cn: 你不受毒液、缠绕、催眠和偷窃效果影响。
effects.summary_en: You are protected from Venom, Constriction, Hypnosis and Pilfering effects.

effects.summary_cn: 若动物行动只打出小型动物，可按正常费用额外打出1只小型动物；之后若展示区有小型动物，可拿取1张。
effects.summary_en: If an Animals action plays only small animals, you may play one additional small animal at normal cost; afterward you may take a small animal from the display if available.

effects.summary_cn: 打出小型动物少支付3金钱。
effects.summary_en: Small animals cost 3 less money.

effects.summary_en: Large animals cost 4 less money.

effects.summary_en: Place on two border spaces; the two border contacts need not be adjacent.

effects.summary_cn: 每个邻接侧门且符合条件的建筑带来2金钱收入（空的普通围栏不计）。
effects.summary_en: Gain 2 money per qualifying building next to the Side Entrance (empty standard enclosures excluded).

effects.summary_en: Gain 5 appeal if your zoo map is completely covered.

effects.summary_en: Gain 1 appeal per connected water space; gain 1 conservation per two unconnected water spaces.

effects.summary_cn: 每个连通的岩石格获得1魅力；每2个未连通岩石格获得1保护分。
effects.summary_en: Gain 1 appeal per connected rock space; gain 1 conservation per two unconnected rock spaces.

effects.summary_en: Gain 1 appeal per connected border space without a building; gain 1 conservation per group of six uncovered spaces.

effects.summary_cn: 若动物园拥有5种动物类别图标，获得1保护分。
effects.summary_en: Gain 1 conservation if your zoo has all five animal-category icons.

effects.summary_cn: 每当动物园首次获得一种新的洲或动物类别图标，获得1魅力和2金钱。
effects.summary_en: When a continent or animal-category icon new to your zoo appears, gain 1 appeal and 2 money.

effects.summary_cn: 社区转录还记录了“每种不同图标2金钱”的效果；自动化前建议核对实体牌上的触发时点。
effects.summary_en: Community transcription also records a 2-money-per-different-icon effect; timing should be verified on the physical card before automation.

effects.summary_cn: 打出大型动物时，可忽略1项条件。
effects.summary_en: When playing a large animal, you may ignore one condition.

effects.summary_cn: 免费放置1个5格普通围栏。
effects.summary_en: Place a size-5 standard enclosure for free.

effects.summary_cn: 每个连通的放置奖励格获得1魅力；每2个未连通的放置奖励格获得1保护分。
effects.summary_en: Gain 1 appeal per connected placement-bonus space; gain 1 conservation per two unconnected placement-bonus spaces.
